verdict.rationale: incident.io documents its own on-call schedules with rotations. Marketing claims shadow schedules and follow-the-sun configurations, which implies time-zone handling, and time-off is surfaced alongside shifts. Schedule layers and round-robin coverage are never evidenced, and time-zone support is only implied, so this is a partial match. missing for 10: explicit documentation of schedule layers, round-robin coverage, explicit per-rotation time-zone configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build on-call schedules with rotations, layers, time zones, and round-robin coverage that match how my teams actually work
